title: Crypto Price Alert (Threshold and Swing)
dataSources: Crypto prices/holdings (`crypto:price`, `wallet:balance`), exchange transactions (`coinbase:txn`), budget/transaction exports (`firefly:txn`, `ynab:txn`), bill feeds.
app: Crypto exchange/wallet APIs (Coinbase, on-chain), budgeting exports (YNAB/Firefly III), and subscription trackers via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=crypto:price
| timechart span=1h latest(price_usd) as price by symbol
| untable _time symbol price
| streamstats current=f last(price) as prev by symbol
| eval pct_change=round(100*(price-prev)/prev,2)
| where abs(pct_change)>5
description: Alerts when a coin you follow moves sharply within an hour or crosses a price you set, so you never miss a big swing.
value: Timely price alerts on your own terms beat doom-scrolling an exchange app all day and help you avoid emotional decisions.
implementation: Ingest prices for your watched symbols; schedule hourly and alert on large swings or threshold crossings.
visualization: Table of symbols by hourly percentage change with alert markers.
grandmaExplanation: It tells you when a coin you follow jumps or drops a lot, so you do not have to keep checking all day.
